events.title: 2026 Pennants Availability (Open)
events.description: 2026 SCDBA Pennants The 2026 SCDBA Pennant Season will be held from Saturday, 25 July to 12 September. The Club Selectors need to have an indication of players wishing to participate. Please also indicate days that you are unavailable. This year, all divisions will be an ‘Open’ competition . All members available, please your place name in the list below and any dates that you are unavailable.

events.title: Contraband
events.description: Formed 14 years ago and counting, Contraband have developed into one of the coasts longest and most consistent bands with their dedicated line up of musicians since 2016. Featuring the magnificent vocal songstress Suzie Keenan with her soaring vocals & dynamic presentation of classics to current top 40 hits. Alexis Sawford on guitar and vocals also lays down some solid songs with his country rock sound, Chris Garey on bass singing some Aussie rock classics and Mark O’Bryen laying down solid grooves on the kit, this band has something for everyone and guaranteed to get you all up and dancing the night away..

events.title: Sunday Club Selected Pairs
events.description: Nominations close at 6pm on the Saturday night prior. Game starts 10am. Green fees and registration by 9.45am. Please enter your name and indicate if you wish to Lead or Skip and if you are a new bowler. Games organiser will select teams and determine format of Pairs eg 2,2,2,2 or 2,4,2 or 3 bowl. If you wish to enter after the event has closed, need to cancel or change your entry, please call Grahan on 0411 502193.

events.title: Proposed Ladies Pennant – Availability
events.description: Proposed 2026 Ladies’ Pennant The Games Committee is calling for expressions of interest from members in playing in a proposed Ladies’ Pennant competition in 2026. This will be a separate competition to the SCDBA Open Pennant. This event will be conducted on Mondays, commencing on 27 July and finishing on 14 September . For further details, please contact Bowls Director, Phil on 0488 221055. Please enter your name to the list below if you are interested.
